notes:
Account background: Ironclad Reach is a tier-1 communications provider (mobile + fixed) with heavy peak-hour traffic. Current Redwood hosted usage ~18M tokens/month (chat + moderation) under annual contract expiring 2026-06. They want to move critical low-latency call-routing and safety moderation to Dedicated, keep embeddings for search on hosted, and adopt Redwood Optimize to reduce per-token cost during daily spikes.

Key asks / requirements: latency p95 < 120ms for call-routing paths; sustained throughput 18k tokens/s for peak-hour; fallback routing to hosted for overflow; EU data residency for user PII; HSM-backed KMS for key custody; SSO via SAML + SCIM. Must pass CISO's penetration checklist and vendor ISO attestation.

Commercials & expansion: AE proposed Dedicated reserved pool (US-east + EU-central) + trial APAC region (Singapore) as optional add-on. Renewal conversation to fold Dedicated commit into new 24-month contract to get unit pricing that beats public-cloud at scale. Customer wants a 30% target reduction in per-token cost with Optimize + batching recommendations.

Technical notes from recent calls: "We can't risk 2x latency in peak — routing fallback must be seamless" (CTO). CISO: "Need HSM proof-of-concept and audit log export to our SIEM". SE to run end-to-end latency bench (Devon). POC scope: 4-week canary in US-east, then EU rollout, then optional APAC pilot.

Risks: procurement timeline pushed by legal on encryption terms; finance requires clearer TCO vs internal GPU farm; potential overlap with existing vendor AnthraTel (security module).

Internal ask: prioritize Optimize enablement workshop (2 days) + dedicated runbook for canary -> canary metrics: error rate <0.1%, fallbacks <1% of requests.
